topography.project_purpose: Derivatives. Structurally: 23 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 4 ERC20 tokens, 1 Chainlink feed; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 5 functional families. Its contracts share 8 common project-authored base contract(s) (erc20permit, eip712, ownableupgradeable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
